offering_description.value: Manufactures nitrogen-based chemicals, including ammonia, nitric acid and ammonium nitrate, sold to mining, industrial and agricultural customers, and makes geothermal and water-source heat pumps for commercial and residential HVAC markets sold through contractors and distributors.

primary_products.value: ammonia; nitric acid; ammonium nitrate; nitrogen fertilizer solutions; geothermal and water-source heat pumps

customer_segment.value: B2B: mining operators, industrial manufacturers, fertilizer distributors and farm cooperatives, HVAC contractors and building owners

end_markets.value: mining; agriculture; industrial manufacturing; commercial construction; HVAC

revenue_model.value: product sales: chemicals sold to industrial, mining and agricultural customers, heat pumps sold to HVAC distributors and contractors

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: takes in natural gas and raw materials to make chemicals and builds heat pumps from purchased components, sold to industrial customers and HVAC distributors

geography_served.value: US national: plants in Oklahoma, Arkansas, Alabama and Texas, customers across the United States with some sales abroad

specialization.value: diversified: chemical business serving mining and agriculture, climate control business making heat pumps for HVAC markets

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: chemical sales to large industrial and mining accounts; distributors / dealers: independent HVAC distributors and fertilizer distributors; own locations: company-operated production plants and sales offices
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: EPA and state environmental permits, OSHA process safety, DOT/PHMSA hazardous materials transport, and DHS chemical security rules for ammonium nitrate

notes: Exact product mix and segment shares may have changed; details are based on general knowledge of the company.
